name: fill-issues-domain
output_contract: Consumes issues-domain.md pending rows; produces (a) yaml rule landings or skip-list conversions per user ruling, (b) three-place closure (table row removal + skip-list sync + changelog entry), (c) AGENTS.md/MEMORY.md snapshot sync (interactive only), (d) optional automation pre-ruling report. Definitive ruling records live only in changelog.md.
rollback_boundary: Ruling mistakes are corrected by a new commit (never amend/rebase pushed commits). Reversed landings move the domain out of the wrong yaml into the correct one with changelog explaining. Skip-to-landing reversals remove the skip: line and add the yaml rule.

input_files.label: file-backed fixture
input_files.role: pending human-review table; rows added by fill-domains-from-log section 6b, removed only by this skill after user ruling

input_files.label: file-backed fixture
input_files.role: machine-readable mapping of already-ruled items (skip=silent skip, manual=human-review visible); manual entries mirror issues-domain.md rows
